traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Sleep Breath
actions.description: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 5 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it. (Descriptive only: Breath Weapons is one shared recharge, and shared recharge is not two actions (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 29). Mechanical Sleep, timed unconscious, and an ends-on-damage break are not authored. Fire Breath is the mechanical save_effect. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
